# Support

This is a one-lot prototype, not a shipped product with player support hours.

1. Run and keys: [`README.md`](../README.md)
2. Design questions: [`PERMIT_DENIED.md`](../PERMIT_DENIED.md)
3. Implementation questions: [`PERMIT_DENIED_GO_IMPLEMENTATION.md`](../PERMIT_DENIED_GO_IMPLEMENTATION.md)
4. How to contribute: [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md)

File a **Bug**, **Playtest**, or **Change** issue when something is wrong or you have a scoped proposal. There is no Discord or forum attached to this repo.

Do not use issues to request a campaign, second lot, between-run meta, or the title `KILLDOZER`.
